name: ex_Fruits.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (apple Ref)(peanut Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Fruit (mk-Fruit (mass Real)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((CitrusFruit (mk-CitrusFruit (mass Real)(vitC Real)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Legume (mk-Legume (mass Real)(protein Real)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Berry (mk-Berry (mass Real)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((SeedyFruit (mk-SeedyFruit (mass Real)(vitC Real)(seeds Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Fruit (sel-Fruit Fruit))
  (lift-CitrusFruit (sel-CitrusFruit CitrusFruit))
  (lift-Legume (sel-Legume Legume))
  (lift-Berry (sel-Berry Berry))
  (lift-SeedyFruit (sel-SeedyFruit SeedyFruit))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Fruit ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Fruit (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Fruit ((this Ref)) Fruit
  (sel-Fruit (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-CitrusFruit ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-CitrusFruit (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-CitrusFruit ((this Ref)) CitrusFruit
  (sel-CitrusFruit (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Legume ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Legume (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Legume ((this Ref)) Legume
  (sel-Legume (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Berry ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Berry (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Berry ((this Ref)) Berry
  (sel-Berry (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-SeedyFruit ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-SeedyFruit (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-SeedyFruit ((this Ref)) SeedyFruit
  (sel-SeedyFruit (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Fruit ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-Fruit this)
    (deref-is-CitrusFruit this)
    (deref-is-Legume this)
    (deref-is-Berry this)
    (deref-is-SeedyFruit this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-CitrusFruit ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-CitrusFruit this)
    (deref-is-SeedyFruit this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Legume ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Legume this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Berry ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Berry this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-SeedyFruit ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-SeedyFruit this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.apple: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!apple ((this Ref)) Ref
  (apple (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.peanut: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!peanut ((this Ref)) Ref
  (peanut (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-CitrusFruit (TopLevelDeclarations!apple this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Legume (TopLevelDeclarations!peanut this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-SeedyFruit (TopLevelDeclarations!apple this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Fruit:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-Fruit Fruit)



; ------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class CitrusFruit:
; ------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-CitrusFruit CitrusFruit)



; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Legume:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Legume Legume)



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Berry:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Berry Berry)



; -----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class SeedyFruit:
; -----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-5-SeedyFruit SeedyFruit)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        4 (lift-Fruit const-4-Fruit))
        3 (lift-CitrusFruit const-3-CitrusFruit))
        1 (lift-Legume const-1-Legume))
        2 (lift-Berry const-2-Berry))
        5 (lift-SeedyFruit const-5-SeedyFruit))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-2-Berry () Berry
  (mk-Berry 2.0))
(define-fun const-3-CitrusFruit () CitrusFruit
  (mk-CitrusFruit 3.0 4.0))
(define-fun const-5-SeedyFruit () SeedyFruit
  (mk-SeedyFruit 8.0 9.0 6))
(define-fun const-4-Fruit () Fruit
  (mk-Fruit 5.0))
(define-fun const-1-Legume () Legume
  (mk-Legume 6.0 7.0))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 5 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (apple (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-SeedyFruit a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (apple (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (or (is-lift-CitrusFruit a!1) (is-lift-SeedyFruit a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (peanut (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Legume a!1)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations
                           (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 5 1)))
                  4
                  (lift-Fruit (mk-Fruit 5.0)))))
(let ((a!2 (store (store a!1 3 (lift-CitrusFruit (mk-CitrusFruit 3.0 4.0)))
                  1
                  (lift-Legume (mk-Legume 6.0 7.0)))))
  (store (store a!2 2 (lift-Berry (mk-Berry 2.0)))
         5
         (lift-SeedyFruit (mk-SeedyFruit 8.0 9.0 6))))))
